parameters.termination: No shortlisted candidate with >=0.1% new sampled area (minimum 2 samples) fits budget; finite candidates; deterministic 2-opt until no improvement, max 8 sweeps. This is a heuristic, not proof of global optimality.
parameters.objective: Feasible first; greedy layer area fraction gain / (0.25+current_layer_coverage) / incremental_seconds^0.6 to avoid starving the small-radius layer; partition by largest summed per-layer field coverage, ties shortest makespan; route length and soft transition penalty.
parameters.coordinate_precision: No intentional rounding; full IEEE double JSON; revalidate serialized artifact.
parameters.geometry_model: Planar metres; 128 segments per circle quadrant; optimization samples 4m grid, final metrics exact polygon Boolean operations with 512-edge disks.

description: Timestamp is persisted for byte-reproducible reruns. Algorithm parameters are explicitly versioned in planner.py; this file records the exact run configuration.
